text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - President Michal Kovac on Wednesday returned, at the government's request, the law halting bank privatisation to parliament for re-assessment.
- State-owned gas distributor SPP took about 10 percent of the state engineering and arms industry coordinator, DMD Holding, in exchange for debts it's owed by engineering companies.

- Peter Weiss, vice-chairman of the opposition Party of Democratic Left (SDL), said the main obstacle for Slovakia's membership in the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is the current untransparent privatisation.

- Deputy Prime Minister Katarina Tothova of the ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS) said she would support a change to direct presidential elections by a constitutional law passed by the parliamant. But she sais she was against the draft law to initiate the move as proposed by the opposition.
- Money market dealers expect interbank rates to remain volatile in the near future.
- Slovakia's gross domestic product per capita totals some $7,090.
- The international telephone country code for Slovakia will be changed to +421, effective March 1, from +42, which, until now, was common for both the Czech and Slovak Republics.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The domestic market can absorb only about 10-15 percent of the overall production capacity of the country's engineering industry.
- French-Slovak GSM operator Globtel has signed roaming agreements with the Czech operator Radiomobil and Austria's MaxMobil.

SME - The opposition SDL said it would support the ruling HZDS in its move to ask the Constitutional Court for an explanation on whether the constitution can be changed by referendum, reffering to attempts of the opposition to use a referendum to change the presidential electoral system.
PRAVDA - Fourteen Slovak theatres said they would strike on Friday to protest treatment by the ministry of culture.
